title: Lovely Smoked Saudi-Arabian Duck Tagine
description: A flavorful and tender Saudi-Arabian inspired dish featuring wholegrain mustard, cured duck, and sweet dates, perfect for a romantic date night. Earthy and aromatic, this recipe is sure to impress.

ingredients.name: Smoking mix (cocoa powder, paprika, brown sugar, cinnamon)
Curing mix (salt, black pepper, coriander, cumin, cinnamon)

instructions: Pat dry the duck leg with paper towels. In a small bowl, mix the curing mix and gently rub it all over the duck leg, making sure to get some under the skin as well.

Place the duck leg on a wire rack over a baking sheet or tray and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight. After the curing time, remove the duck from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the smoking mix, ghee, and pomegranate molasses (if using). Rub the mixture all over the duck leg, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Place the duck leg on the preheated raclette grill and smoke for 2 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 135°F (57°C).
While the duck is smoking, heat the chicken broth in a saucepan over medium heat.
After the duck has smoked for 2 hours, remove it from the grill and place it in the saucepan with the heated chicken broth.
Add the pitted dates, chopped parsley, chopped cilantro, and lemon juice to the saucepan with the duck and broth.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes, or until the duck is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove the duck from the saucepan and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the duck with the sauce spooned over the top and garnished with additional parsley and cilantro, if desired.
